body:
ASVS is quite an extensive standard covering a lot of specific and wide topics with the clauses. At this scale its only natural for people to come across inconsistencies when understanding as well as implementing certain clauses. 

Digging the web I could not find any place where you can ask questions about a specific clause and spark a discussion about its validity, implementation and so on. Well, except for this github, but to be honest a Github Issues is really not a user friendly platform for Q&A and such. 

Apart from that, ASVS lacks any sort of an implementation guide tailored towards developers/admins. It is a bare list of clauses with some descriptions throughout them. The usability of a standard mostly comes from how accessible it is to get help for implementing it, in my opinion. 

So I'd suggest creating a forum-like platform ( a mailing list, an online forum or such) that would be a central place for people to get help regarding any questions about the current standard, as well as a small implementation guide that might cover the most problematic clauses and the best practices of covering them. 

We are currently in the process of adopting the ASVS in our company. And we want to make it accessible and easy for everyone. Yet we came across some issues regarding some clauses, which we couldn't resolve due to either misunderstanding or lack of an implementation guide. That's what prompted me to open this issue. We are willing to help with anything we can.

comments.body:
My first ideas of reading the issue:
* ASVS is purely meant only for requirements. Nothing else.
* If the requirement itself is not clear, then it makes sense to open issue for that.
* If you want to ask question, maybe it's better to do it in Slack channel.
* If there is need to point to some implementation - then it makes sense to follow technology specific best practices - it's not imaginable and in scope for ASVS to cover all that
* if it general security (implementation or testing) problem, then it's most likely covered by cheat sheet project (and no need to have the overlap)

Implementation guide is topic to cover, but in my opinion, mostly from organization point of view, not some technical step-by-step how to be valid for this requirement.

Can you give me some examples, what kind of question you or some one may have, which requires extra platform like forum, and does not suit to GitHub issue or slack channel?

Can you give me some examples, what do you mean by "implementation guide". To take in use ASVS in general or requirement-by-requirement, how to be "valid" or compatible with that?

What we have now (few years) is the rule - that we have issue for every change in requirements. And we should be able to trace back to the reasons, why some change was made. For sure there are some exceptions.

An example of how I'd imagine the future of ASVS would be like how [iso27001security](https://www.iso27001security.com) is to ISO27K standard. It is a really solid and mature website that provides users with a forum to discuss anything even remotely relevant to 27001 and also some tools, guides, faq, charts (and whatnot) to help in getting your hands dirty with it. 

The thing about ASVS is that it presents a really comfortable set of requirements that can be checked in an automated manner during a SDLC. We are trying to do just that, and it presents us with some questions that make you think "I wonder how other people dealt with this.", but then again, there is no place to ask for it. 

As an example question we faced during the task of ASVS automation is how to deal with complex single page applications for specific clauses. The issue is that crawling a single page application is a very hard task, so that presents an issue of not testing the "un-crawled" parts of the application. One solution is using say an OpenAPI definition of the application, and not relying on crawling at all, but then it presents issues with defining endpoints that are way to complex to be able to put in a schema. 

This of course sounds like something out of ASVS's scope so asking it here wouldn't be wise, but is definitely something people will face when trying to comply for ASVS in the long term, so an answer to it will also be very valuable.

As for the implementation guide, it really is something to think about thoroughly, so I cant really point to anything right now and say "well, something like this".

ASVS should only give you WHAT you need to test, and you kind of should know yourself, WHY it is important.

If there is in general question HOW to test something, then those topics should be covered by testing guide.

If there is specific question, how to optimize your used tool or scanner, then it's question to this tool/scanner related forums.

In short, I can not see clear problem here (based on given examples) on the ASVS side. ASVS should and will stay really focused on requirements.

I have opened the discussions forum for now although we will have to see how effective it is:
https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/discussions

There is also the channel in the OWASP slack instance:
https://app.slack.com/client/T04T40NHX/C06MNF14M

(Self registration from here: https://owasp.org/slack/invite)
